D: Young Jim Hawkins and his Muppet friends sail off with a treasure map and a ship's cook named Long John Silver.
P: Serve the main when Long John Silver cooks in the ship's galley.
S: Roasted mini sausages glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard

Little chipolatas roasted in a sticky honey and wholegrain mustard glaze, sprinkled with thyme and served on toothpicks. Twist 20 chipolatas in half to make 40 little sausages and snip apart. Roast on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 1 tsp soy sauce. Pour over the sausages, toss and roast 8 minutes more until sticky and glazed. Scatter with thyme leaves and serve on toothpicks.
Crisp cheddar and black pepper crackers with apple and pickled onion

Homemade crunchy cheddar and pepper crackers, served with sliced apple and pickled onions like sea rations from the ship's stores. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, then stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar, 1/2 tsp cracked pepper and a pinch of salt. Add 2 tbsp cold water and press into a dough. Chill 20 minutes. Roll to 3mm, cut into 5cm squares, prick with a fork and bake at 180C for 14 minutes until golden. Cool. Serve with 2 sliced apples and a few pickled onions.
M: Tomato fish stew with white fish, prawns and potato, garlic toast

Chunks of white fish and prawns in a smoky tomato, potato and paprika broth, served with garlic toast for dunking. Fry 1 diced onion, 1 diced capsicum and 2 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp smoked paprika, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 500ml fish stock and 400g diced potatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish chunks and 200g peeled green prawns and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in parsley. Rub toasted sourdough with garlic and serve alongside.
W: Dark chocolate brownies topped with chocolate coins

Fudgy brownies dusted with cocoa sand and piled with gold-wrapped chocolate coins and gold sprinkles, a treasure chest in every square. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 100g plain flour and 30g cocoa. Spread into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Cool, then crush 4 plain biscuits and sprinkle over like sand. Cut into 16 squares and top each with a gold chocolate coin and gold sprinkles.
K: Ginger beer, pineapple, lime and orange over ice, no alcohol

Spicy ginger beer with fresh lime, orange and a splash of pineapple juice over ice, a rum-free grog for the whole crew. In a jug, mix 1L cold ginger beer, 300ml pineapple juice, the juice of 2 limes and the juice of 1 orange. Fill 4 tall glasses or tin mugs with ice and pour over. Garnish with lime wedges and orange slices.
